description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAttachmentDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class is responsible for data access operations related to employee attachment records, including retrieval, insertion, and deletion of attachments from the database.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeAttachment entity, providing methods to query and manipulate employee attachment data in the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PartialEmployeeAttachment objects for a specific employee and screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a single EmployeeAttachment object based on employee number, attachment ID, and optional screen.

methods.name: getPartialEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a partial view of an EmployeeAttachment as a PartialEmployeeAttachment object, optionally filtered by attachment ID and screen.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves a new or existing EmployeeAttachment entity to the database, assigning a unique attach ID if not already set.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee attachments based on employee number, screen, and list of attachment IDs.
